Still a candidate, left out of the 15:

- Interactive Animal Skinning VR (188121, needs HIGGS, VRIK, PLANCK; written by Claude). Its author warns that QuickLoot IE, already on the page, still opens the animal's corpse.
- SpellBender VR (164902): Panda's Sovngarde and Tempus Maledictum VR. Spells steer after the controller. Incompatible with Spell Auto-Aim VR.
- VR Follower Gesture Command (173336): give followers orders with gestures, work in progress.
- Dead Weight VR (182364, Tahrovin): halves damage when a two-handed weapon is held in one hand through HIGGS.
- Follower Jumping Framework (193226): Yggdrasil VR from 2026-10-02, with VR stated as tested.
- Unique Region Names Framework VR (190139): Stormcrown VR, but the VR file is marked Untested.
- Edge UI - VR Edition (168702, Tempus Maledictum VR): an alternative to Norden UI VR.
- Compass Navigation Overhaul VR - Reconstructed (189884): about 99% written by AI, unofficial, and its author says the page may be removed.
- 3D Interface Replacement Project (Journal) (186015): a 3D quest journal as a book in the hand. It is a beta that only handles US-ASCII text, so Cyrillic will not display.

Not recommended or worth checking:
- Native Water Light Stabilizer (186700): states SE/AE/VR support and Yggdrasil VR 2.2 added it. But one Nexus user reports Open Shaders does not load with it enabled, so test it only together with Open Shaders 2.17.
- Open Shaders With DLSS5 Neural Rendering (190062): an unofficial experimental fork, do not mix with Open Shaders.
- Precision Physic Bodies and VR Touch Events: a female-body and SkyrimNet adult context, not for the core.
- Hitch Hunter (194231) and Havok Solver Crash Fix (194392): found only for SE/AE, no VR evidence.
- RaceMenu VR 2 is the only new VR UI mod I found that is in no list. If it doesn't suit, the proven option is RacemenuVR 0.5 (156898, 4 VR lists, August 2025, outside the date window).
- VRIK Closed Fist is optional because VRIK already has a ShowFistWhileUnarmed setting that does the same.
